brief: Holds a section, the start and end positions of a stretch of a list or a string, checked against the size of that host.
detail: Build one with new stzSection(n1, n2, nSize) or StzSectionQ(n1, n2, nSize); the global Section(n1, n2, nSize) answers just the [ start, end ] list and IsSection(n1, n2, nSize) tells whether the three numbers make a valid section. The positions may be keywords (:First, :Last) or named places ([ :From, 3 ], [ :To, 6 ]). Positions count from 1 and negative ones are refused. The check is incomplete: a start past the size is accepted when the end is inside, and nothing orders the two positions.
